text:
mila (product): Heads-up: adaptive-burst routing pilot next week. We need one-pager GA criteria: SLA text, pilot billing behavior, runbook, monitoring checks, and public docs. Who takes what?

josh (eng): I can own service metrics and fallback behavior doc. Quick question: public SLA or pilot-only internal SLO?

irma (pricing): Pricing prefers opt-in surcharge for pilot. If opt-in, propose multiplier 1.6x for burst tokens. Need example invoice line and FAQ blurb.

mila (product): Pilot = internal performance SLO + single public availability promise. Internal SLO: p99 < 420ms. Public: availability 99.9% (routing service).

sara (docs): I'll draft the public "expectations" doc and a short FAQ. Need exact wording for availability and the billing sample.

josh (eng): Implementation note: fallback plan: fallback to quantized variant when queue depth > X or latency alert fires. We'll include quality caveat. I'll document trigger thresholds.

deepak (sre): Runbook: detection -> temp throttle -> switch to fallback -> escalate -> rollback. Pager thresholds: p99 > 650ms for 5m OR error rate > 4% for 5m. I'll write the runbook and link monitoring dashboards.

lina (support): Support playbook: disable opt-in for affected customers as workaround, provide billing preview, escalate to eng after 10m if >5 customers impacted. I'll prepare canned responses.

ops-bot: Created ticket: PBR-2026-adaptive-burst-pilot (assign: deepak).

irma (pricing): Confirming multiplier 1.6x and opt-in only. Also request that Console show an estimated "burst cost" before enable. Can product confirm?

mila (product): Yes — Console must show estimated monthly impact when opt-in is toggled. @josh add a metrics export for billing calc.

josh (eng): Will add metrics: tokens_routed_burst, burst_windows_count, burst_duration_ms. Example query for billing: SELECT sum(tokens_routed_burst) * multiplier FROM bursts WHERE customer_id=...

sara (docs): Example invoice line I'll draft: "Adaptive Burst Surcharge (opt-in) — 1.6x tokens routed during burst windows" with a small table showing sample math. Will get pricing signoff.

mila (product): Owners summary: SLA & metric definitions -> josh; runbook & alerts -> deepak; pricing text + Console billing preview -> irma + josh; customer docs + FAQ -> sara; support templates -> lina. Finalize public wording Thu EOD.

josh (eng): One more technical note: fallback variant may change latency distribution and token usage (quantized may use fewer tokens but lower quality). We'll capture sample diffs from staging.

deepak (sre): I'll add synthetic checks: route correctness, fallback engagement rate, and end-to-end latency by region. Also create a dashboard panel for "burst impact".

lina (support): I'll add a short "how to opt-out" step in support KB and instructions to verify routing state in Console.

irma (pricing): I'll prepare the billing preview UI copy and a short paragraph for the FAQ about "why you're charged" and "how to disable".

sara (docs): Draft will go to #product-docs in a few hours. Finance/pricing review requested.

mila (product): Thanks. Action items: josh -> post staging numbers + trigger thresholds; deepak -> runbook PR + dashboards; irma -> billing preview copy; sara -> docs draft; lina -> support templates. Recheck Thu 9:30 PT. Any blockers?

josh (eng): Blocker: need decision on default opt-in state. Recommend default OFF for pilot.

mila (product): Default OFF. Customers must explicitly enable. Noted.

(ended thread)
